Kuutinkämppä

Location

The cabin is 3 km from the entrance of Saarijärvi, next to the Mustalamminvuori hill on the shore of Kuutinlahti. You are not allowed to drive there by a motor vehicle.

Cabin furnishings

Bunk beds with mattresses, mattress covers, blankets and pillows.
